knownDeltas: The crate now freezes selection, compact feedback, and date-time value semantics as token-backed GPUI specs before mounted native widgets exist for every control family.
Roving-focus, open-state, range, and popup ownership semantics are explicit in the API even where actual focus and overlay plumbing remain later runtime work.
Date and time values remain contract-owned local strings or objects rather than platform-native date objects or timestamps.
nonGoals: Do not treat this tranche as proof that GPUI overlay, disclosure, navigation, menu, or workstation primitives are complete.
Do not replace contract-owned value objects with runtime-native date or time objects in the public API.
Do not claim final native accessibility proof from spec-level selection and popup models alone.
